WITH a_src AS (
  SELECT
    "Quote Scope Items Name" AS key_name,
    "Average Cost Per Year"  AS avg_cost_per_year,
    "Average Price Per Year" AS avg_price_per_year,
    "CBS Element"            AS cbs_element,
    "Cost Owner"             AS cost_owner,
    "Currency"               AS currency,
    "End Year (Opex)"        AS end_year_opex,
    "Expiration Date"        AS expiration_date,
    "Offer Scope"            AS offer_scope,
    "Product"                AS product,
    "Product Code"           AS product_code,
    "Product Family - Sub"   AS product_family_sub,
    "Quantity"               AS quantity,
    "Quantity Unit"          AS quantity_unit,
    "Quote"                  AS quote,
    "Sales Release Status"   AS sales_release_status,
    "Scope Description"      AS scope_description,
    "Scope Group"            AS scope_group,
    "Scope Type"             AS scope_type,
    "Standard Price"         AS standard_price,
    "Start Year (Opex)"      AS start_year_opex,
    "Total Cost"             AS total_cost,
    "Total Cost Opex"        AS total_cost_opex,
    "Total Price Opex"       AS total_price_opex,
    "Turbo Quote Items"      AS turbo_quote_items,
    "Unit Cost"              AS unit_cost
  FROM #{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_smart_list","line":"654236f0","path":["list_name"]}')}
),
b_src AS (
  SELECT
    "Quote Scope Items Name" AS key_name,
    "Average Cost Per Year"  AS avg_cost_per_year,
    "Average Price Per Year" AS avg_price_per_year,
    "CBS Element"            AS cbs_element,
    "Cost Owner"             AS cost_owner,
    "Currency"               AS currency,
    "End Year (Opex)"        AS end_year_opex,
    "Expiration Date"        AS expiration_date,
    "Offer Scope"            AS offer_scope,
    "Product"                AS product,
    "Product Code"           AS product_code,
    "Product Family - Sub"   AS product_family_sub,
    "Quantity"               AS quantity,
    "Quantity Unit"          AS quantity_unit,
    "Quote"                  AS quote,
    "Sales Release Status"   AS sales_release_status,
    "Scope Description"      AS scope_description,
    "Scope Group"            AS scope_group,
    "Scope Type"             AS scope_type,
    "Standard Price"         AS standard_price,
    "Start Year (Opex)"      AS start_year_opex,
    "Total Cost"             AS total_cost,
    "Total Cost Opex"        AS total_cost_opex,
    "Total Price Opex"       AS total_price_opex,
    "Turbo Quote Items"      AS turbo_quote_items,
    "Unit Cost"              AS unit_cost
  FROM #{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_smart_list","line":"4a05a824","path":["list_name"]}')}
),

-- Normalize: trim, empty -> NULL, cast numerics/dates, lowercased key for join
a AS (
  SELECT
    LOWER(TRIM(key_name))                                 AS key_norm,
    NULLIF(TRIM(key_name), '')                            AS key_name,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(avg_cost_per_year),  '') AS NUMERIC) AS avg_cost_per_year,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(avg_price_per_year), '') AS NUMERIC) AS avg_price_per_year,
    NULLIF(TRIM(cbs_element),           '')               AS cbs_element,
    NULLIF(TRIM(cost_owner),            '')               AS cost_owner,
    NULLIF(TRIM(currency),              '')               AS currency,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(end_year_opex),   '') AS INTEGER)    AS end_year_opex,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(expiration_date), '') AS DATETIME)   AS expiration_date,
    NULLIF(TRIM(offer_scope),           '')               AS offer_scope,
    NULLIF(TRIM(product),               '')               AS product,
    NULLIF(TRIM(product_code),          '')               AS product_code,
    NULLIF(TRIM(product_family_sub),    '')               AS product_family_sub,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity),        '') AS NUMERIC)    AS quantity,
    NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_unit),         '')               AS quantity_unit,
    NULLIF(TRIM(quote),                 '')               AS quote,
    NULLIF(TRIM(sales_release_status),  '')               AS sales_release_status,
    NULLIF(TRIM(scope_description),     '')               AS scope_description,
    NULLIF(TRIM(scope_group),           '')               AS scope_group,
    NULLIF(TRIM(scope_type),            '')               AS scope_type,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(standard_price),  '') AS NUMERIC)    AS standard_price,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(start_year_opex), '') AS INTEGER)    AS start_year_opex,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(total_cost),      '') AS NUMERIC)    AS total_cost,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(total_cost_opex), '') AS NUMERIC)    AS total_cost_opex,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(total_price_opex), '') AS NUMERIC)   AS total_price_opex,
    NULLIF(TRIM(turbo_quote_items),     '')               AS turbo_quote_items,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_cost),       '') AS NUMERIC)    AS unit_cost
  FROM a_src
),
b AS (
  SELECT
    LOWER(TRIM(key_name))                                 AS key_norm,
    NULLIF(TRIM(key_name), '')                            AS key_name,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(avg_cost_per_year),  '') AS NUMERIC) AS avg_cost_per_year,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(avg_price_per_year), '') AS NUMERIC) AS avg_price_per_year,
    NULLIF(TRIM(cbs_element),           '')               AS cbs_element,
    NULLIF(TRIM(cost_owner),            '')               AS cost_owner,
    NULLIF(TRIM(currency),              '')               AS currency,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(end_year_opex),   '') AS INTEGER)    AS end_year_opex,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(expiration_date), '') AS DATETIME)   AS expiration_date,
    NULLIF(TRIM(offer_scope),           '')               AS offer_scope,
    NULLIF(TRIM(product),               '')               AS product,
    NULLIF(TRIM(product_code),          '')               AS product_code,
    NULLIF(TRIM(product_family_sub),    '')               AS product_family_sub,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity),        '') AS NUMERIC)    AS quantity,
    NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_unit),         '')               AS quantity_unit,
    NULLIF(TRIM(quote),                 '')               AS quote,
    NULLIF(TRIM(sales_release_status),  '')               AS sales_release_status,
    NULLIF(TRIM(scope_description),     '')               AS scope_description,
    NULLIF(TRIM(scope_group),           '')               AS scope_group,
    NULLIF(TRIM(scope_type),            '')               AS scope_type,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(standard_price),  '') AS NUMERIC)    AS standard_price,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(start_year_opex), '') AS INTEGER)    AS start_year_opex,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(total_cost),      '') AS NUMERIC)    AS total_cost,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(total_cost_opex), '') AS NUMERIC)    AS total_cost_opex,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(total_price_opex), '') AS NUMERIC)   AS total_price_opex,
    NULLIF(TRIM(turbo_quote_items),     '')               AS turbo_quote_items,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_cost),       '') AS NUMERIC)    AS unit_cost
  FROM b_src
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(a.key_name, b.key_name) AS key_name
FROM a
FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.key_norm = b.key_norm
WHERE
  -- keep rows missing on either side
  a.key_norm IS NULL OR b.key_norm IS NULL

  OR NOT ( (a.product              = b.product              OR (a.product              IS NULL AND b.product              IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.product_code         = b.product_code         OR (a.product_code         IS NULL AND b.product_code         IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.product_family_sub   = b.product_family_sub   OR (a.product_family_sub   IS NULL AND b.product_family_sub   IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.quantity             = b.quantity             OR (a.quantity             IS NULL AND b.quantity             IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.quantity_unit        = b.quantity_unit        OR (a.quantity_unit        IS NULL AND b.quantity_unit        IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.quote                = b.quote                OR (a.quote                IS NULL AND b.quote                IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.sales_release_status = b.sales_release_status OR (a.sales_release_status IS NULL AND b.sales_release_status IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.scope_description    = b.scope_description    OR (a.scope_description    IS NULL AND b.scope_description    IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.scope_group          = b.scope_group          OR (a.scope_group          IS NULL AND b.scope_group          IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.scope_type           = b.scope_type           OR (a.scope_type           IS NULL AND b.scope_type           IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.standard_price       = b.standard_price       OR (a.standard_price       IS NULL AND b.standard_price       IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.start_year_opex      = b.start_year_opex      OR (a.start_year_opex      IS NULL AND b.start_year_opex      IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.total_cost           = b.total_cost           OR (a.total_cost           IS NULL AND b.total_cost           IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.total_cost_opex      = b.total_cost_opex      OR (a.total_cost_opex      IS NULL AND b.total_cost_opex      IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.total_price_opex     = b.total_price_opex     OR (a.total_price_opex     IS NULL AND b.total_price_opex     IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.turbo_quote_items    = b.turbo_quote_items    OR (a.turbo_quote_items    IS NULL AND b.turbo_quote_items    IS NULL)) )
  OR NOT ( (a.unit_cost            = b.unit_cost            OR (a.unit_cost            IS NULL AND b.unit_cost            IS NULL)) )

# ✅ Workato Ruby code step
# Inputs expected:
#   output   -> String or Hash (may contain a nested "formatted_json" that is itself a JSON string)
#   wrap_key -> Optional. When the top-level is an Array, it will be wrapped into { wrap_key: [...] }.
#               Defaults to "items".
#
# Returns:
#   {
#     data: <Hash|Array>,           # the real parsed object (use this in formulas / loops)
#     data_wrapped: <Hash>,         # always a Hash; if data was an Array it's wrapped under wrap_key
#     data_pretty: <String>,        # pretty-printed JSON for display/logs (don't map from this)
#     meta: { source: <String> }    # tells which branch was used
#   }
#
# Usage tip:
#   In downstream steps, map from `data` (or `data_wrapped` if an object is required).

require 'json'

def safe_parse_json(value)
  case value
  when String
    begin
      JSON.parse(value)
    rescue => e
      raise "Failed to parse JSON string: #{e.message}\nValue (truncated): #{value[0,300]}"
    end
  when Hash, Array
    value
  when NilClass
    raise "Expected 'output' but got nil"
  else
    raise "Unsupported type for JSON parsing: #{value.class}"
  end
end

wrap_key = (input['wrap_key'] || 'items').to_s

begin
  # 1) Parse the first level (could already be a Hash, or a JSON string)
  level1 = safe_parse_json(input['output'])

  # 2) Determine the actual payload:
  #    - If there's a "formatted_json" field and it's a String, parse it again.
  #    - Else if there's an already-object field like "formatted_object" or "data", use it.
  #    - Else use level1 as-is.
  candidate =
    if level1.is_a?(Hash) && level1.key?('formatted_json') && level1['formatted_json'].is_a?(String)
      meta_source = 'formatted_json (double-encoded)'
      safe_parse_json(level1['formatted_json']).tap { |_| @meta_source = meta_source }
    elsif level1.is_a?(Hash) && level1.key?('formatted_object') && (level1['formatted_object'].is_a?(Hash) || level1['formatted_object'].is_a?(Array))
      @meta_source = 'formatted_object'
      level1['formatted_object']
    elsif level1.is_a?(Hash) && level1.key?('data') && (level1['data'].is_a?(Hash) || level1['data'].is_a?(Array))
      @meta_source = 'data'
      level1['data']
    else
      @meta_source = 'level1 direct'
      level1
    end

  # 3) If the top-level is an Array, wrap it so downstream mappers that expect an object won’t error.
  data_wrapped =
    if candidate.is_a?(Array)
      { wrap_key => candidate }
    elsif candidate.is_a?(Hash)
      candidate
    else
      # Fallback: coerce scalars to an object
      { value: candidate }
    end

  # 4) Pretty JSON for display/logging only
  data_pretty =
    begin
      JSON.pretty_generate(candidate)
    rescue
      candidate.to_s
    end

  {
    data: candidate,                 # ← use this for real data operations
